what: Jacobs Solutions is an engineering and consulting firm. It designs and manages infrastructure projects: water treatment, transport, airports, semiconductor and pharmaceutical plants, and advises governments on major programmes.
customers: Government agencies, water and transport authorities, semiconductor and life sciences manufacturers, and energy companies.
money: water, transport, semiconductor and life sciences project delivery
moat: Technical expertise and long-standing framework agreements with government agencies, where qualification and security clearances take years to obtain.
risks: Net margin of about 2% reflects a people business with pass-through costs
Government budget cycles determine project timing
opportunities: Revenue grew about 5% last year and about 7% a year over three years
Separating the government services business left a higher-margin company
Semiconductor and water infrastructure programmes are in a multi-year build cycle
watch: Backlog growth and adjusted operating margin.
